name: Inverted row
equipment: sturdy table, low bar or rings
summary: Hang under a bar or a sturdy table with straight body and pull your chest up to it. The home version of a row and the first step toward a pull-up.
setup: Lie under a sturdy table (test it first) or a bar set at waist height. Grip the edge or bar a little wider than shoulder width.
Straighten your body from head to heels, heels on the floor. Bending your knees makes it easier.
Hang with straight arms and your shoulders slightly forward.

steps.text: Pull your shoulder blades back first, with straight arms. Your chest lifts a little.
Pull your chest to the bar, driving your elbows back along your sides at about 45 degrees from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together for a moment. Shoulders stay down, away from your ears.
Lower under control to straight arms, letting the shoulder blades slide apart at the end.

jointCues.cue: Back and down to start each rep, squeezed together at the top.
jointCues.why: Rows train the muscles that pull the shoulder blades together; starting there makes them do the work instead of the arms.

jointCues.cue: About 45 degrees from your body, finishing just behind your torso.
jointCues.why: Elbows straight out to the sides shift the work to the rear shoulders and upper traps; pulling far past the body tips the shoulder forward.

jointCues.cue: Straight; hold the bar like a hook.
jointCues.why: Curling the wrists turns it into a biceps exercise.

jointCues.cue: Rigid plank from heels to head. Glutes tight.
jointCues.why: If the hips sag, the hips do part of the lifting and the back does less.

breathing: Breathe out as you pull, breathe in as you lower.
tempo: Pull 1 s, squeeze 1 s, lower 2 s

mistakes.fault: Hips sag on the way up
mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes, or bend your knees to make it easier.

mistakes.fault: Chin pokes forward to reach the bar
mistakes.fix: Lead with the chest; keep the neck long.
Pull the shoulders down before you pull up.

safety: Use only a table that cannot tip: test it by pulling on the edge before lying under it.

cues.text: Shoulder blades back first, arms still straight
Top: squeeze the shoulder blades together, shoulders down
Body stays one rigid line from heels to head
Drive the elbows back along your sides
